description_en: Queries the primary/secondary switchover logs of an instance
description_zh: 查询实例的主备切换日志
name: DescribeDBInstanceSwitchLog

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: an integer greater than 0 and less than or equal to the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30、50、100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

LogItems.description_en: The list of primary/secondary switchover logs

NodeId.description_en: Instance ID of the instance if the instance is a replica set instance, or instance ID of the switched node if the instance is a sharded cluster instance
NodeId.description_zh: 当实例为副本集实例，展示实例ID；当实例为分片集实例，展示切换的节点ID
NodeId.example:
当实例为副本集实例：dds-uf68f1b5a57exxxx。
当实例为分片集实例：d-uf652b73f554xxxx

SwitchCode.description_en:
The cause code of the switchover. Valid values:
USER_CONSOLE_OPERATION: manual operation
OPERATION_AND_MAINTENANCE: potential risk
MACHINE_DOWNTIME: host offline
PRIMARY_UNHEALTHY: instance failures
SECONDARY_UNHEALTHY: instance failures
MULTIPLE_NODE_FAILURES: instance failures
SwitchCode.description_zh:
切换原因代码：
USER_CONSOLE_OPERATION：人工操作
OPERATION_AND_MAINTENANCE：风险隐患
MACHINE_DOWNTIME：宿主机下线
PRIMARY_UNHEALTHY：实例异常
SECONDARY_UNHEALTHY：实例异常
MULTIPLE_NODE_FAILURES：实例异常

SwitchStatus.description_en:
The switchover status. Valid values:
1: The switchover is successful.
0: The switchover failed
SwitchStatus.description_zh:
切换状态。
返回值为：
1：切换成功。
0：切换失败

SwitchTime.description_en: The switchover time. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of primary/secondary switchover records returned in the query
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询结果中主备切换记录的数量
